curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42078-1-1.pdf (the tractor is bags 1-4, the trailer and its two cranes bags 5-6, the container bag 7; the functions on pages 420-421)

functions.does: The gear on top at the back of the cab roof steers the front wheels: a shaft runs down the back of the cab to an 8 tooth gear and a 24 tooth gear, whose arm works the steering links.
functions.source: book: bag 3 steps (the hogxmit gears), page 420 (bottom left photo, the arrows on the roof gear and the front wheel)

functions.does: Pushed along, the tractor's two rear axles drive the six cylinder engine under the bonnet: each axle has a differential, a shaft through universal joints runs forward to the crankshaft, and the six pistons run up and down.
functions.source: book: bag 1 steps 3-15 (the two differentials and the shaft between them), engine steps in bag 2; page 420 (top right photo, the arrows on the pistons)

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely; they aren't driven.
functions.source: inferred: no drive shaft reaches the front axle

functions.does: The bonnet, with the grille, headlights and front wings, tips forward to show the engine.
functions.source: book: page 420 (top middle photo, the arrow on the bonnet)
inferred: page 420 (top left photo) draws an arrow at the cab side; the doors hang on bar hinges (cabindoorhinge1 and 2)
functions.note: unsure the arrow means the doors; it may mean the side fairing below them

functions.does: The fifth wheel at the back of the tractor slides forward and back.
functions.source: inferred: page 421 (top left photo) draws a long arrow along the tractor's rear frame beside the fifth wheel plate
functions.note: unsure which part slides, or whether the arrow only shows where the trailer hooks on

functions.does: The trailer swings on its king pin behind the tractor.
functions.source: book: bag 5, the trailer front (trailerfront.ldr) and its king pin

functions.does: The black gear low on the side of the trailer's front winds the landing gear's two legs, with their little wheels, down to the ground and back up.
functions.source: book: step 68 on page 296 (the arrows on the gear and the legs), page 421 (the gear marked at the trailer's front)

functions.does: One of the two black gears at the trailer's rear works both cranes' large linear actuators together, swinging each crane's long leg out until it stands on the ground beside the trailer and back in: a shaft runs forward under the deck through constant velocity joints from the rear crane to the front one.
functions.source: book: bag 6 crane steps (the large actuators and the long shafts, page 342 shows the shafts plugging in); page 421 (middle photo, the arrow along the leg; the rear gear marked)
functions.note: which of the two rear gears works which crane function is inferred from the model's shafts

functions.does: The other black gear at the trailer's rear works both cranes' small linear actuators together, swinging each crane's green arm up and over to lift the container on its four chains, and back: a row of five 16 tooth gears under the deck passes the turn across to a second shaft that runs to both cranes, where bevel gears and universal joints take it up to each actuator.
functions.source: book: bag 5 steps 15-24 (the row of gears, pages 268-271), bag 6 crane steps; page 421 (right photo, the arrows on the arm and the leg)
functions.note: which of the two rear gears works which crane function is inferred from the model's shafts

functions.does: Each crane leg is a rack in a housing that telescopes, so the leg can reach the ground as it swings out.
functions.source: inferred: the legs are built from a 1 x 14 rack and its housing (pages 329-332); page 421 (middle photo, the arrow along the leg)
functions.note: unsure whether the legs telescope by hand or are driven

functions.does: The container's two end doors swing open.
functions.source: inferred: container steps 52-53 and 69 (pages 412-418) build the doors on their own hinge axles

functions.does: The trailer's four wheels roll freely.

questions.question: Which knob does which, where the book doesn't label them?
